text:
Maya: Heads-up: saw two incidents last week where a missing safetensors index caused full warmup to hang and pushed nodes into OOMs. Proposal: introduce an index-gate in the loader that classifies artifacts as VALID / MISSING_INDEX / BAD_INDEX before warmup and routes accordingly.

Ibrahim: Totally. Current behavior of retrying the index read with long backoff just blocks the worker. Gate sounds right.

Jordan: What does BAD_INDEX mean vs MISSING_INDEX?

Maya: BAD_INDEX = index present but checksum mismatch or truncated. MISSING_INDEX = no index offset in header. Both should fall back to the tarball stream path, but we treat BAD_INDEX as higher severity for metrics and quarantine logic.

Priya: How do we surface this to customers? Silent fallback could be confusing for perf-sensitive users.

Maya: Console timeline entry + model load trace: "fallback: safetensors index missing" and a short link to the artifact id. Also emit metric safetensors.fallback{reason="missing"|"bad"}.

Ibrahim: From infra: we need a per-artifact counter metric: safetensors.fallback_count{artifact_id}. We'll use that for quarantine. Proposal: after 3 fallbacks within 24h -> mark QUARANTINED. Quarantined artifacts get routed to pinned-previous if present; otherwise block new hotstarts and surface an escalation in console.

Jordan: Quarantine workflow sounds good. Do we want an operator CLI to manually clear quarantine? e.g., `reconcile-artifact --unquarantine <artifact>`

Priya: Yes, operator CLI + API. Also automatic cooldown: quarantine expires after 7d unless new fallbacks continue. Add runbook steps for producers to reupload.

Maya: Implementation notes: loader flow: read first 4KB header -> parse safetensors header fields -> emit header.inspect and header.checksum metrics -> classify. Pseudocode:

    header = read_prefix(source, 4096)
    if not header.has_index_offset():
      reason = "missing"
    elif not verify_checksum(header.index_checksum):
      reason = "bad"
    else:
      reason = "ok"
    emit_metric("safetensors.index_check", reason=reason)
    if reason != "ok":
      emit_metric("safetensors.fallback_count", artifact_id=artifact.id)
      loader = TarballStreamLoader(source)
    else:
      loader = SafetensorsIndexedLoader(source)
    return loader.hotstart_stream()

Ibrahim: Note: the pseudocode includes artifact_id in metric tags. Our metric cardinality rules: tag by hashed_artifact (sha1 prefix) not raw id. ops-bot can help implement.

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Metric tagging guideline: use hashed_artifact prefix (8 chars). Will add hashing helper in metrics lib.

Jordan: Any change needed to WeightSource API? I think we can keep same stream return type, but add early handshake metadata: {index_status: "ok"|"missing"|"bad", loader_variant: "safetensors_indexed"|"tarball_stream"}. Caller code can choose to surface a warning.

Priya: That handshake metadata is useful. Keep it optional so older callers ignore it. Add integration test that asserts handshake metadata present for new clients.

Maya: Ops cost concern: tarball streaming is heavier. To avoid load spikes, when fallback triggered by many requests concurrently, we should stagger warmup (jitter + tokenized-layer-first). Suggest runtime change: fallback warmup uses prioritized layer queue (embed+LMHead first).

Ibrahim: Good. Also add circuit-breaker: if an artifact triggers >20 concurrent fallbacks across cluster in 1h, temporary cluster-level throttle to avoid burst CPU. We'll surface a cluster alert then.

Priya: I'll draft a one-page RFC addendum covering: index-gate classification, metrics names/thresholds, quarantine policy, handshake metadata, and console UX text.

Maya: I'll implement the loader guard + unit tests. Jordan can own the API handshake change and the console string. ops-bot + dev-bot to wire alerts and metrics retention.

dev-bot: Created alert stubs: SAFETENSORS_FALLBACK_HIGH (>=20 concurrent fallback events in 1h), SAFETENSORS_QUARANTINE_TRIGGER (artifact fallback_count >= 3 in 24h). Linked runbook: /runbooks/safetensors-fallback.

ops-bot: Metrics retention: fallback counters hashed by artifact -> 30d. Quarantine state persisted in artifact-catalog DB with TTL 7d. CLI command added: `artifactctl unquarantine <artifact-hash>`.

Jordan: One more idea: add a producer-side validation hook in the artifact pipeline that rejects uploads missing a valid index for safetensors; that will reduce noisy fallbacks. Not as quick but worth doing.

Maya: Agree. Add issue in infra backlog and mark P1 for next sprints if we see >5 quarantines in a week.

Priya: I'll attach sample console copy in RFC: "Fallback to legacy stream due to missing safetensors index — performance may be reduced. See artifact details."

Maya: Great. We'll iterate on thresholds after we collect initial telemetry. Thanks all — filing PR + RFC now.

Jordan: :+1:

Ibrahim: LGTM
